title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a penalty term. This penalty term is controlled by the hyperparameter lambda. Can you think about how adding a penalty might affect the values of the parameters?

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: When you increase lambda, the penalty on the size of the coefficients increases. This means that the model will try to keep the coefficients smaller. How might this affect the estimated parameters?

title: Impact on Coefficients
text: As lambda increases, what happens to the estimated coefficients in ridge regression?

title: Balancing Fit and Complexity
text: Ridge regression aims to balance the fit of the model with the complexity of the model. Increasing lambda emphasizes simplicity over fit. How does this trade-off manifest in the parameter estimates?
